context: Ren reports a budget on cleanup to Hiroshi-boss.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business report; vocabulary (汚染/支出/経緯/失わ/向かう) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 工場の汚染対策を、まとめました。
lines.en: I compiled the factory's pollution measures.
lines.style: measured young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 汚染に至った経緯は、分かったかね?
lines.en: Did you find the process that led to pollution?
lines.style: attentive boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 経緯を、詳しく調べました。

lines.style: precise young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 対策の支出は、どのくらいかね?
lines.en: How much is the spending on measures?

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 支出は、来年度に計上します。

lines.style: confident young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 信用を、失わないようにな。
lines.en: Make sure we don't lose trust.
lines.style: firm boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 信用を失わず、改善に向かいます。
lines.en: Without losing trust, we'll head toward improvement.
lines.style: reliable young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 解決に向かう道を、示してくれ。
